title: Vintage & Exotics Laverda Jota 1000 Legend
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Laverda Vintage & Exotics Laverda Jota 1000 Legend is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 1000cc powertrain delivering 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 230 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
